latestVersion.changelog:
Free-to-Video-AI v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Convert text or images into 1080p video clips for free using AI-powered cloud rendering.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG files up to 200MB.
- Quickly generate and export high-quality MP4 videos in about 1–2 minutes per clip.
- Session-based workflow: automatic token setup, file uploads, timeline editing, previews, and exports.
- Includes status tracking, credits checking, and error handling for common issues.
- Designed for easy use by content creators—no installation required; runs entirely on cloud GPUs.
